name: Bren Thalle
role: Sheaf and Bowl stall-holder, Crossing market row — and two dry seasons behind on everything
knowledge: What a stall on the Crossing row actually clears in a bad season
Mining work, from before — and what it does to hands
Which wells in the Crossing cleared first, because she boiled from all of them
wants: Her two children through to the far side of this
One true answer instead of a kind one
fears: ⚠️ Being cornered again into a choice she would not otherwise make. ⛔ And being handled — she asked plainly for one true thing and got it, and remembers who gave it.
appearance: Broad through the shoulders, thirties, hands worn to the shape of a mining tool she no longer uses. Grief carried without display.
voiceHints: Plain and short. She asks the actual question rather than the polite one, and files the answer without ceremony.

reactsToReputation.truthful: tells you what a season really cleared
reactsToReputation.evasive: stops asking and serves you anyway
reactsToReputation.kind: lets you see the back house

abilities.why: ⚑ mining work. `strength: 8` is the highest of her attributes and it is not decorative
she read rock for a living before she read a market row
⚑ a stall-holder two dry seasons behind knows exactly what everything is worth
⚠️ the back house with two children in it — that is the craft
⛔ 'asked plainly for one true thing' — she gives what she asks for

physicality: ADULT. Broad-shouldered and heavy-handed, thirties, the forearms of someone who moved rock for years. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: she does not perform being alright, and she does not perform being not-alright either.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ `romanceEligible: false` — she has two children in the back house and is two dry seasons behind, and this entry exists so a GM can DESCRIBE her, not court her. ⚠️ Touch is a hand taken briefly in thanks and a door held open. ⛔ The thing she will not discuss is what the bad choices were.
_genderFix_20260906: ⛔ THE FILE DISAGREED WITH ITSELF, and CCode flagged it. The registry `description` read 'A BROAD MAN, thirties' while the history says 'HER children in the back house' TWICE, across separate beats. ⚠️ AND THERE WAS NO `gender` FIELD AT ALL — rule 14B: 'IF YOU LEAVE IT OUT THE PORTRAIT IS A COIN TOSS and the game will render them wrong in front of the player.' ✅ RESOLVED AS A WOMAN: the history is the stronger evidence — written across multiple turns, consistent, and ABOUT her rather than a passing adjective in a one-line description. ⚑ 'Broad' is kept in `appearance` and `physicality`, because it was never the part that conflicted.
_promotedFrom: ⚑ Registry entry `bren-thalle`, relationship 5, first met Millbrook d5. R28: generated is promotable to authored. Crafts drawn from her history — mining work, the stall, the back house, and asking plainly for one true thing.
questSeeds: She will not ask, but the Sheaf and Bowl is two dry seasons behind and the back house has two children in it. Offer to look at the books and she will let you — once.
She was cornered into a bad choice before and someone is setting up the same corner. She will name it plainly if you ask the actual question rather than the kind one.
_questSeedsWhy: ⛔ SNG-167 §2. 'A LOCATION can start an arc and a PERSON cannot — rule 10 weaves the location's questSeeds and there is no equivalent for anyone you meet. THAT IS BACKWARDS: THE MEMORABLE ARCS START WITH SOMEONE, NOT SOMEWHERE.' ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-06: ZERO of 48 NPCs carried a seed and every one fell back to the derived want — and the ratchet went red at 48 because Aevi authored a 48th person without one. ⚑ A SEED IS AN ERRAND THE PERSON WOULD ACTUALLY ASK FOR, drawn from their own `wants` and `fears` — not a hook the world hands them. ⛔ R49's shape: a seed that names no objective is a nebulous hook one layer down.
